on_screen_text:
Client de saamne... sirf is karke beizzati hoi kyonki mainu English nahi aundi si [In front of the client... I was insulted just because I didn't know English]
Boss ne keha: 'Agli vaar, tusi na boliyo.' [Boss said: 'Next time, you don't speak.']
Us din main faisla kar liya... is beizzati nu apni motivation banaavaanga. [That day I made a decision... I will make this insult my motivation.]
Mere kol paise nahi san English classes join karan layi. [I didn't have money to join English classes.]
Phir main sochiya... AI ton English sikhda haan. [Then I thought... let's learn English from AI.]
"MySivi app te main AI de naal ghantiyan takk gallan kitiyan." [On MySivi app, I talked with AI for hours.]
AI ne mainu meri Punjabi bhaasha vich hi English sikhai. [AI taught me English in my Punjabi language itself.]
Kise de judge kite bina... main confidence naal bolna sikh gaya. [Without anyone judging... I learned to speak with confidence.]
"Kujh hi dinaan baad... client ne vadda order de ditta." [Just a few days later... the client gave a big order.]
Us din samajh aa gaya... English sirf ikk bhaasha nahi, zindagi badlan da mauka vi hai. [That day I understood... English is not just a language, it's also an opportunity to change life.]
summary: An animated story of a Punjabi-speaking office worker who gets embarrassed in front of a client due to his poor English. Unable to afford classes, he uses the MySivi app to practice English with an AI in Punjabi, eventually gaining the confidence to secure a major client order.
